newsitem.title: USA: VIMRx begins Phase I/II hepatitis drug test.
newsitem.headline: VIMRx begins Phase I/II hepatitis drug test.

text.p: VIMRx Pharmaceuticals Inc said Wednesday it has begun a Phase I/II clinical trial for VIMRxyn, its drug to treat infectious chronic hepatitis C.
The trial will test 24 patients taking VIMRxyn once a day for two months. Trial results should be available in nine months, the company said.

About 150,000 people in the United States are newly infected with Hepatitis C virus each year, and it is estimated that four million people in total are infected, VIMRx said. The disease can cause cirrhosis of the liver and liver cancer.
The company said interferon alpha-2b is the only drug approved for treating the disease in the U.S.
